extracted.intended_audience: researchers, journalists, advocates, and members of the public who search or use CPJ's database of attacks on the press
extracted.subtask_description: Using CPJ's online database to find and filter records of attacks on the press (killed, imprisoned, missing). The page describes the available datasets, searchable fields, and points users to the Data Methodology, FAQs, and Glossary for research approach and definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Killed (dataset)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the four datasets CPJ carries; selectable in the search form. Learn more about this dataset's scope and research approach in the Data Methodology, FAQs, and Glossary. Note: The data below is updated continually as new information becomes available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currently Imprisoned (dataset)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the four datasets CPJ carries; selectable in the search form. See Data Methodology, FAQs, and Glossary for definitions, inclusion criteria, and research approach. Data are updated continually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imprisoned (Annual Dec 1 Snapshot) (dataset)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An annual snapshot dataset (Dec 1) maintained by CPJ and selectable in the search form. Consult Data Methodology and FAQs for the snapshot's methodology and inclusion rules. Data are updated continually when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing (dataset)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the four datasets CPJ carries; selectable in the search form. Definitions and research approach are available in the Data Methodology, FAQs, and Glossary. Data are updated continually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name (search field)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A searchable field in the database form for filtering records by the individual's name. The page instructs users to 'Complete the form above to begin searching the CPJ database.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization (search field)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A searchable field for the journalist's or media organization's affiliation used to filter results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date (search/filter field)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A field/filter for the date of the incident or record. The page also shows a 'Years to' range control to restrict results by time period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location (search field)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A searchable field for the geographic location of the incident (country, region, etc.). The interface includes controls to show more or fewer countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attack (search field)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A field in the search form to filter by the kind of attack on the press; users can select attack types when querying the database.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of Death (data field)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A specific field applicable to the 'Killed' dataset describing the manner or classification of death; useful for filtering and analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charge (data field)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A field applicable to imprisoned records listing the formal charge(s) brought against the journalist; used for search and categorization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Years (range filter)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A range control in the form allowing users to restrict search results to a particular time span.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Methodology, FAQs, and Glossary (methodological guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn more about the four datasets CPJ carries and its research approach in the Data Methodology, FAQs, and Glossary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs users to these resources for detailed definitions, inclusion criteria, research approach, and other standards that govern how CPJ collects, classifies, and updates records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency / update frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: The data below is updated continually as new information becomes available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CPJ indicates the database is maintained on an ongoing basis; users should expect records and counts to change over time as new information is added or corrected.
